description.value: The Murrayville Library is a branch of the Fraser Valley Regional Library system, serving the Murrayville neighbourhood of Langley as a free public institution. It offers access to library collections, digital services, public computers, and printing. Touring cyclists passing through Langley may find it a convenient community hub for a rest indoors.
